description: This file is a C header (.h) defining interface declarations related to WebPA, including function prototypes, macro definitions, and references to external dependencies such as wifi_hal_generic.h. It sets up function signatures for URL retrieval, component finding, message sending, and device MAC address retrieval, and includes macro constants.

methods.name: get_parodus_url
methods.description: Retrieves the URL where parodus is listening, with output via a char** parameter.

methods.name: Cosa_FindDestComp
methods.description: Finds the destination component based on object name, outputs destination component name and path.

methods.name: sendWebpaMsg
methods.description: Sends a WebPA message with specified parameters including service name, destination, transaction ID, content type, payload, and payload length.

methods.name: getDeviceMac
methods.description: Returns the MAC address of the device as a string.
